title: Looker Dashboard Query Runtime p95
app: Looker System Activity via DB Connect/API; Looker instance logs via UF; plan and query events via HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=looker:system_activity source="history" status="complete"
| eval dur_s=round(runtime/1,2)
| stats avg(dur_s) as avg_s, p95(dur_s) as p95_s, count as runs by dashboard_title
| where p95_s>30
| sort - p95_s
description: Computes the 95th-percentile query runtime for each dashboard in Looker and flags the slowest, pointing owners at the specific content or jobs that need optimisation.
value: Tail latency, not the average, is what users feel; ranking Looker dashboards by p95 focuses tuning effort where it removes the most pain.
implementation: Ingest Looker timing data; schedule daily over a trailing week and review the slowest dashboards with their owners.
visualization: Table of dashboard by p95 query runtime, trend line.
grandmaExplanation: We measure how slow the worst cases are in Looker so the sluggish ones get fixed before people give up on them.
